Here’s the complete 12-week plan summary (strength, cardio, HIIT, power, nutrition/recovery) starting Monday 2026-06-01, aligned to her 28-day cycle with flow windows on Jun 26–28, Jul 24–26, and Aug 21–23 (Days 1–3 each cycle = no high-intensity, no heavy Valsalva, no jumping).

Structure
- Days/week: 4 strength sessions (Mon, Tue, Thu, Sat) + Power (Wed) + HIIT (Fri) + Zone 2 cardio layered Tue/Wed/Sat; optional easy cardio Fri/Sun when HIIT deloads.
- Phases:
  - Weeks 1–4 Accumulation 1 (technique/volume; RPE 6–7; deload on Week 4 flow days)
  - Weeks 5–8 Accumulation 2 → Intensification (pushed intensity; top sets to RPE 8–8.5; deload on Week 8 flow days)
  - Weeks 9–12 Intensification → Peak (heaviest exposures; deload/taper on Week 12 flow days)
- Global rules
  - Progression: Add 1–5 kg when all sets hit target RPE with speed. Back-offs −5–10% from top sets.
  - Flow Days 1–3: swap barbell compounds for machine/DB, RPE ≤6, no jumps/HIIT; emphasize mobility and easy Zone 1–2.
  - Warm-up 8–12 min; cool-down 5–8 min.
  - Bracing: normal on non-flow days; avoid heavy Valsalva during flow.

Weekly overview (by session type)
- Mon Lower A (Squat focus)
- Tue Upper A (Bench/horizontal pull) + Zone 2
- Wed Power/Plyometrics (then optional Zone 2)
- Thu Lower B (Hinge focus)
- Fri HIIT (erg-based)
